## Download and run

| Your computer | Download | Then |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows** (64-bit) | `TrackSound-windows-x64.zip` | Unzip, open the `TrackSound` folder, double-click **TrackSound.exe**. If Windows says "Windows protected your PC", click **More info → Run anyway** (the app isn't code-signed yet). |
| **Mac** (Apple Silicon: M1 and later) | `TrackSound-macos-arm64.zip` | Unzip, open the `TrackSound` folder, **right-click TrackSound → Open → Open** the first time (the app isn't notarised yet). |
| **Linux** (64-bit) | `TrackSound-linux-x64.tar.gz` | Extract, then run `TrackSound/TrackSound`. |

TrackSound opens in your web browser. Keep its window open while you use it; close the window to stop it.

Intel Mac, or prefer a terminal? Use the one-line installer from the README; it works on every platform.

The `.whl` file is the Python package (`uv tool install <file>.whl`).
